hero.text: Competitive and recreational dance training in a professional, positive environment where dancers are challenged, supported and inspired.
hero.stat_text: Training the next generation of dancers

intro.paragraph1: AIM provides quality dance education for competitive and non-competitive students, with a strong focus on proper technique across every style.
intro.paragraph2: Our goal is simple: create passionate, dedicated dancers in a positive studio environment and give them the tools to succeed both inside and outside the dance world.

programs.name: Recreational Dance
programs.description: Weekly classes designed to build technique, confidence, creativity and a love of dance.

programs.name: Competition Team
programs.description: Advanced training, rehearsals and performance opportunities for dedicated dancers.

programs.name: Dance Genres
programs.description: Explore Ballet & Pointe, Jazz, Tap, Lyrical, Contemporary, Hip Hop, Acro and Jumps & Turns.

programs.name: Summer Programs
programs.description: Keep dancers moving, training and growing through seasonal summer opportunities.

programs.name: Birthday Parties
programs.description: Celebrate your dancer with a fun and memorable birthday experience at AIM.

programs.name: Kickline Technique
programs.description: Focused training designed to strengthen precision, performance quality and kickline technique.
